findings.summary: The nudge adds app-mediated sending to another account, but no authorization policy governs the affordance or MessageDraft, and no send-time revocation check is modeled; every other stored entity has a governing policy.
findings.evidence: Links added: nudge writes entity.MessageDraft and MessageDraft storedIn binding.contactsStore; there is no 'governs' link to either. policy.revocation: 'Read and send authorization must check revocation against current authoritative state'; operation.connection.revoke: 'a block prevents new app-mediated contact until removed'.

findings.summary: The affordance's effect is delivery of a card to the recipient, but it only writes a draft; no send/deliver operation, delivery state or recipient-side surface is defined.
findings.evidence: effects: 'Delivers a short "thinking of you" card from the owner to the connected person inside the app'; the only link is 'writes entity.MessageDraft' (state: string, 'no autonomous send'); there is no operation link and no screen shows received nudges.

findings.summary: The new criterion and affordance have no requirement or source backing: the criterion has no sourceRefs, unlike its siblings, and the affordance omits source, while MessageDraft drops its provisional flag without a supporting spec section.
findings.evidence: C.webapp.nudge.single has no sourceRefs (C.webapp.contact.storage has 'sourceRefs: [S.webapp.operations]'); the nudge affordance has no 'source:' entry; the diff removes '- provisional: true' from entity.MessageDraft.
